changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Record the open weekly digests' contact cutoffs as UTC instants.

customChange.param: SELECT e.id, e.workspace_id, e.payload #>> '{window,weekStart}', e.payload #>> '{window,zone}' FROM conversation_entry e JOIN conversation_turn t ON t.id = e.turn_id AND t.workspace_id = e.workspace_id WHERE e.kind = 'DIGEST' AND t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND e.payload -> 'startBy' IS NULL AND e.payload #>> '{window,weekStart}' IS NOT NULL AND e.payload #>> '{window,zone}' IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE OF e
UPDATE conversation_entry SET payload = jsonb_set(payload, '{startBy}', to_jsonb(CAST(? AS text))) WHERE id = ? AND workspace_id = ?

rollback.stop: Restore the verified database backup taken before the digest cutoff backfill.
